rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality full/expanded blastocyst, thinned zona, plausible ICM and TE appearance, and appropriately notes image quality limits. Minor issue: questions the 3AA vs expanded terminology without direct image-based certainty.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, PCOS, smoking, prior ectopic, sperm parameters, oocyte maturity, and endometrium with embryo quality and transfer prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors. Minor overreach in inferring fresh-cycle endometrial effects without explicit confirmation of fresh vs frozen transfer.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, ectopic surveillance, smoking cessation, consideration of freeze-all in high-response PCOS, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Small deviation in emphasizing hydrosalpinx workup without explicit tubal history details.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, serial beta-hCG, early ultrasound, smoking cessation, tubal evaluation, luteal support, and metabolic optimization.
